source: Measured from the LDraw part files for parts that no connector source covers. Each row says where its numbers come from.

32293.note: s/32293s01.dat (the socket end) placed at 0 0 0 in parts/32293.dat

2739a.note: s/2739as01.dat (the socket end) placed at 0 0 0 in parts/2739a.dat

4254.note: parts/4254.dat: the shaft runs from the head's shoulder (4-4disc at y -15) to the part's end at y -80; radius 6 is the bore it runs in

4255.note: parts/4255.dat: the tube's mouth, 4-4cyli of radius 6 at y 38, to the tube's end at y 58

92906.note: The cup of 'Technic Steering Constant Velocity 4.8mm Joint Female': the shadow library's SNAP_GEN nudge1 (sph 6) at 0 0 0; the shaft is its own axle, along z in parts/92906.dat.

32494.note: The ball of 'Technic Wheel Spindle Axle Driver': SNAP_GEN nudge1 (sph 6) at 0 0 0; the shaft is its axle hole, along z in parts/32494.dat.

92909.note: The cup inside 'Technic Steering Wheel Hub for Portal Axle': SNAP_GEN nudge1 (sph 6) at 0 0 30; the hub turns about z in parts/92909.dat.

51377.note: The hub's pin hole, in s/51377s02.dat (placed at the origin, unturned): 4-4cyli of radius 6 from z 2 to 18, then peghole.dat (the counterbore: radius 8, 2 deep) from z 18 to 20, open at both ends. Neither primitive has a snap in the shadow library. Part file: parts/51377.dat.

30285.note: The hub's pin hole, in s/51377s02.dat (placed at the origin, unturned): 4-4cyli of radius 6 from z 2 to 18, then peghole.dat (the counterbore: radius 8, 2 deep) from z 18 to 20, open at both ends. Neither primitive has a snap in the shadow library. Part file: parts/30285.dat.

30155.note: parts/30155.dat: the hub's pin hole, 4-4cylo of radius 6 from z -8 to 8, with 4-4ring3 (radius 6 to 8) at each end and no counterbore.

2998.note: The hub's pin hole, in s/2998a.dat placed at 0 0 13 in parts/2998.dat (turned about z): peghole.dat (radius 8, 2 deep) from z 0 to 2, 4-4cyli of radius 6 from 2 to 18, peghole.dat from 20 back to 18. The shadow library's connhole. The six holes in the spokes (s/2998b.dat) are not here.

6580a.note: The hub's axle hole: s/6580b.dat, placed twice at 0 0 22 in parts/6580a.dat with its x along -z, holds axlehol6.dat (the hole's teeth) from its x 1 to 21, so from z 21 to 1. axlehol6 has no snap in the shadow library.

6014b.note: The hole 6014a has (the same body, s/6014s01.dat, and a hole of radius 4 from z 8 inward), here notched: wpinhol2.dat, which has no snap in the shadow library. This is the connector the shadow library gives 6014a, its SNAP_INCL of 4624.dat: a SNAP_CYL at 0 0 8 with its sections along -z.
